Iran holds funeral for Supreme Leader Ali Khamenei amid regional tensions

Iran has begun days of funeral ceremonies for Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei in Tehran, with large crowds gathering. Senior Iranian officials and representatives from over 70 nations attended the event. The funeral occurs amidst ongoing regional conflict and has seen calls for revenge from Iranian officials.
